facts.fact: ANGOP reports the minister reinaugurated INFOSI's requalified Backup Data Center in Luanda on 2026-08-25, which forms part of the government Data Center and Cloud opened in April 2026 at Camama; main site in Camama (Luanda), backup in Luanda (INFOSI), exact backup place not stated beyond Luanda.

systems.system: Data Center e Cloud do Governo (Camama)

facts.fact: PTI reports the government cloud backup centre, housed at INFOSI in Luanda with 48 racks and about 8.5 PB, was reinaugurated on 2026-08-25 and replicates in real time the data of the government data centre at Camama; main site in Camama, backup in Luanda (INFOSI premises).

facts.fact: ANGOP reports INFOSI and FADCOM signed on 2026-08-25 an internship protocol at the government's Backup Data Center, which is operating; place of the backup site not stated, place of the main site not stated.

note: INFOSI organic statute (2021-05-31, truncated at Art. 22); names the Centro Nacional de Dados and its shared-services department but states nothing on a backup or DR site, plan, test or Tier.
Imprensa Nacional's own data centre is described as fully redundant; no backup site or its place is named.
BPC's disaster-recovery backup is at Bravantic premises in no named place, so distance is not known.
Geographic redundancy is only a requirement for certification entities the decree may set, no backup site stated.
Modernisation and disaster-recovery site only authorised for procurement; none in service.
